hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Set only by the combined pipeline after validating the banner release tuple.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT_TUPLE_SHA256
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Canonical digest emitted by the banner rollout validator.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT_DEPLOYMENT
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Deployment whose exact tuple was validated by the combined pipeline.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_BACKEND_HEALTH_RECEIPT
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Set by the combined pipeline after the backend aggregate health probe passes.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLBACK
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Use only for the frontend-first rollback path with a validated FRONTEND_ALLOWED attestation.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Machine-checkable rollback state. Do not include secrets.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" == "true" && "${BANNER_ROLLBACK:-false}" == "true" ]]; then echo "ERROR: forward rollout and rollback modes are mutually exclusive." >&2 exit 2 fi if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLBACK:-false}" == "true" ]]; then if [[ -z "${BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON:-}" ]]; then echo "ERROR: frontend rollback requires a FRONTEND_ALLOWED attestation." >&2 exit 2 fi rollback_attestation=$(mktemp) trap 'rm -f "${rollback_attestation}"' EXIT printf '%s' "${BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON}" > "${rollback_attestation}" python3 "${JENKINS_HOME}/banner-rollout/validate-banner-rollout.py" \ --rollback-attestation "${rollback_attestation}" \ --jenkins-source-commit "${JENKINS_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \ --required-rollback-stage FRONTEND_ALLOWED fi
if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" == "true" ]]; then if [[ "${BANNER_BACKEND_HEALTH_RECEIPT:-}" != "BACKEND_AGGREGATE_HEALTH_VERIFIED" ]]; then echo "ERROR: banner frontend publication requires the backend health receipt." >&2 exit 2 fi python3 "${JENKINS_HOME}/banner-rollout/validate-banner-rollout.py" \ --deployment "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_DEPLOYMENT}" \ --tuple-sha256 "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_TUPLE_SHA256}" \ --jenkins-source-commit "${JENKINS_SOURCE_COMMIT}" fi
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}" stack_s3_bucket="${S3_BUCKET_NAME}"
# Source folder containing the scripts source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/"
# Iterate through the files in the folder and source them shopt -s nullglob for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do if [ -f "$script_file" ]; then chmod +x "$script_file" echo "sourcing $script_file" # shellcheck source=/dev/null source "$script_file" fi done shopt -u nullglob
for fn in assume_role wait_for_command reset_role; do if ! command -v "${fn}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: required function '${fn}' is not loaded from ${source_scripts_folder}" >&2 exit 1 fi done
assume_role
frontend_commit=$(aws s3api head-object \ --bucket "${stack_s3_bucket}" \ --key "${TARGET_STACK}/containers/pic-sure-frontend.tar.gz" \ --query 'Metadata."git-commit"' \ --output text) if [[ "${frontend_commit}" == "7b69aa960ff98f97c1a2d026b7137b0e3dcdf603" && "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" != "true" ]]; then echo "ERROR: reviewed banner frontend artifact requires the combined banner pipeline." >&2 exit 2 fi if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" == "true" && "${frontend_commit}" != "7b69aa960ff98f97c1a2d026b7137b0e3dcdf603" ]]; then echo "ERROR: frontend artifact does not match the reviewed banner commit." >&2 exit 2 fi
# Download the terraform state file echo "Download terraform.tfstate file for $TARGET_STACK stack" aws s3 cp "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/deployment_state_metadata/${TARGET_STACK}/terraform.tfstate" terraform.tfstate
# Extract the Wildfly EC2 instance ID echo "Extract HTTPD instance ID for $TARGET_STACK stack" httpd_instance_id=$(jq -r '.outputs["httpd-ec2-id"].value' terraform.tfstate) echo "${httpd_instance_id}"
update_httpd_container="sudo sh /opt/picsure/deploy-httpd.sh --stack_s3_bucket $stack_s3_bucket --target_stack $TARGET_STACK" echo "$update_httpd_container"
update_httpd_container_json=$(jq -n --arg cmd "$update_httpd_container" '{commands: [$cmd]}') echo "JSON version of run command: $update_httpd_container_json"
command_id=$(aws ssm send-command \ --instance-ids "${httpd_instance_id}" \ --document-name "AWS-RunShellScript" \ --comment "Deploy httpd in place" \ --parameters "$update_httpd_container_json" \ --query "Command.CommandId" \ --output text)
wait_for_command "${command_id}" "${httpd_instance_id}"
reset_role
